# Load workbooks
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(src)

ws = wb["Formula Required"]
wsv = wbv["Formula Required"]
ws_group = wbv["Grouping"]

# 1. Map Grouping data
# Grouping sheet: A=Main Group, B=Material, C=0-6m, D=6m-1y, E=1-2y, F=2-3y, G=3-4y, H=4-5y, I=More than 5y
grouping_data = []
for row in ws_group.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=7):
    grouping_data.append([cell.value for cell in row])

# 2. Define the logic for the answer cells D3:J6
# Rule: If Material (Col B) is present, look up Material in Grouping Col B.
# If Material (Col B) is absent, look up Main Group (Col C) in Grouping Col A.

for r in range(3, 7):
    material = wsv.cell(row=r, column=2).value
    main_group = wsv.cell(row=r, column=3).value
    
    lookup_val = None
    search_col_idx = -1 # 0-indexed
    
    if material is not None:
        lookup_val = material
        search_col_idx = 1 # Column B
    elif main_group is not None:
        lookup_val = main_group
        search_col_idx = 0 # Column A
    
    # Fill columns D (4) to J (10)
    for c in range(4, 11):
        # Grouping columns for values are C, D, E, F, G, H, I (indices 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)
        # Col D (4) -> index 2
        # Col E (5) -> index 3
        # ...
        # Col J (10) -> index 8
        val = None
        if lookup_val is not None:
            for g_row in grouping_data:
                if g_row[search_col_idx] == lookup_val:
                    val = g_row[c - 2]
                    break
        ws.cell(row=r, column=c, value=val)

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(out)
